shared_elements: monolithic upright slab/pillar carved in low relief
stylized anthropomorphic/composite figure occupying the whole slab
arms/limbs rendered in shallow relief on the body of the stone
horizontal registers or bands crossing the body
small animal or creature forms in relief
justification: Both show a large upright slab treated as a schematic body, with low-relief motifs organized into horizontal registers and shallow arms/limbs indicated on the stone's face, plus discs and small creature-like forms. But the specific iconography differs entirely: A shows a row of quadrupeds/birds above a band of arm-like curves and dangling elements, while B shows a helmeted or headdressed frontal figure with pectoral discs and belt bands, so the correspondence is only at the generic level of 'anthropomorphic pillar with registers'.
